notes: irreversible; ~+0.9-1.0 V vs SCE reported (Fukuzumi); also photoexcited directly under violet light in some reactions

name: indole
functional_groups: indole pi -> radical cation (C3 nucleophilic / N-H deprotonation -> indolyl radical)
notes: approximate

name: iodobenzene
notes: Ep/2 value (half-peak potential); irreversible

name: iodoform
notes: E_red not confidently known; readily reduced (more positive than CH2I2); left null

name: lepidinium (protonated 4-methylquinoline)
functional_groups: protonated heteroarene; radical acceptor in Minisci
notes: approximate; TFA-protonated; verify

name: mesitylene
functional_groups: arene radical cation -> benzylic C-H deprotonation -> benzyl radical
notes: irreversible

name: methyl 4-iodobenzoate
notes: Ep/2 value (half-peak potential); irreversible; approximate, verify

name: methyl acrylate
notes: approximate; usually acts as radical acceptor rather than SET acceptor

name: methyl vinyl ketone
notes: approximate; polymerizes on reduction

name: methyl viologen
conversion: E(vs SCE) = E(vs NHE) - 0.241 (from -0.45 V vs NHE)
notes: reversible

name: morpholine
notes: rough estimate for secondary amine; secondary amines oxidize ~0.2-0.4 V more positive than tertiary

name: N,N,N',N'-tetramethylethylenediamine

notes: approximate; irreversible

name: N,N-diisopropylethylamine

name: N,N-dimethylaniline

name: N-(acetoxy)phthalimide
